issue.title: Spaced . and ; alias fallbacks fire inside record key:: values, where Bob opens no picker and writes a stray * or @
issue.description: The completion-gated . -> & and ; -> * fallbacks (expand_dot_dependency_alias, expand_semicolon_blocked_task_alias, expand_modifier_fallback_alias in src/native/capture_language/rewrite.rs) and the earlier . -> @ route_after_text fallback do not know a bullet under an @dir/ record item is an opaque record field value, so they rewrite there although no picker would open.

task_type_fields.impact: Rare (a space then `.` or `;` typed inside a `key::` value of a record item), and the Mac fast-key escape restores the typed literal, but the stored field value can gain a stray `*` or `@`. Fix direction from the report: suppress the spaced-alias fallbacks inside first-level `key::` value bullets of record items (the Mac already has the `record_value` context from capture-complete, or capture-rewrite learns the record route shape). Record values have been opaque since bob-cli-ir.6 07ff3bf0. Surfaced during the Record Notes landing; filed by the bob-cli-j6 lander when closing the epic, since the DISCOVERED ISSUE note on j6 would otherwise lose its owner.
task_type_fields.repro:
Needs a built `bob` (no vault needed for the rewrite):

    printf 'Ninja Sushi @eat/\n- category:: sushi ;' | bob capture-rewrite -f json -c 37
    # text: 'Ninja Sushi @eat/\n- category:: sushi *'   rule expand_sigil_alias, alias blocked_task
    printf 'Ninja Sushi @eat/\n- category:: sushi .' | bob capture-rewrite -f json -c 37
    # text: 'Ninja Sushi @eat/\n- category:: sushi @'   rule expand_sigil_alias, alias route_after_text

(`-c` is the byte length of the draft.) Reproduced independently by the bob-cli-j6 lander on master 4321fd70's tree with a freshly built bob, matching bob-cli-ir.land's DISCOVERED ISSUE note #3 on bob-cli-j6. With a records config `restaurant` (dir `eat`), `bob capture-complete -c END` on the same draft with a trailing `&` instead of `;` reports context `record_value` and opens no picker, so the rewrite's own gate rule (only where a bare sigil would open a picker) is violated.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ir.land found on integration that bob capture-rewrite's vault-free fallbacks rewrite . and ; inside opaque record field values; the bob-cli-j6 lander is closing the epic that introduced the fallbacks, so the issue needs its own task.

payload.description: The j6 epic introduced the . -> & and ; -> * fallbacks; ir.land recorded this as DISCOVERED ISSUE note #3 on it
